diapositivas.codigoAnimacion:
<a-entity id="escena_estudio" position="0 0 0" scale="0.12 0.12 0.12">

    <!-- 1. ILUMINACIÓN HOLOGRÁFICA (Genera sombras, brillos metálicos y volumen real) -->
    <a-light type="ambient" color="#94a3b8" intensity="0.9"></a-light>
    <a-light type="point" color="#38bdf8" intensity="2" distance="12" position="0 3 2"></a-light>
    <a-light type="point" color="#f59e0b" intensity="1.2" distance="8" position="0 -2 1.5"></a-light>

    <!-- 2. PLATAFORMA HOLOGRÁFICA (Base de proyección sobre la diapositiva) -->
    <a-entity position="0 -1.8 0">
        <!-- Anillo exterior giratorio -->
        <a-ring radius-inner="3.2" radius-outer="3.45" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #38bdf8; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.65; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: rotation; to: -90 360 0; dur: 22000; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-ring>
        <!-- Anillo interior con pulsación neón -->
        <a-ring radius-inner="2.1" radius-outer="2.3" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #818cf8; emissive: #4f46e5; emissiveIntensity: 0.9; opacity: 0.55; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: scale; to: 1.1 1.1 1.1; dir: alternate; dur: 2200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        </a-ring>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 3. ÁTOMO / NÚCLEO CIENTÍFICO FLOTANTE (Símbolo de Metodología y Ciencia) -->
    <a-entity position="0 2.2 -0.2"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 2.45 -0.2; dir: alternate; dur: 2800; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Núcleo central brillante -->
        <a-sphere radius="0.32" 
            material="color: #38bdf8; emissive: #0ea5e9; emissiveIntensity: 1; roughness: 0.1">
        </a-sphere>
        <!-- Órbita 1 (Inclinada 45°) -->
        <a-entity rotation="45 30 0"
            animation="property: rotation; to: 45 390 0; dur: 6000; loop: true; easing: linear">
            <a-torus radius="0.85" radius-tubular="0.018"
                material="color: #67e8f9; emissive: #06b6d4; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.75; transparent: true">
            </a-torus>
            <a-sphere radius="0.08" position="0.85 0 0" 
                material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #38bdf8; emissiveIntensity: 1">
            </a-sphere>
        </a-entity>
        <!-- Órbita 2 (Inclinada -45°) -->
        <a-entity rotation="-45 -30 0"
            animation="property: rotation; to: -45 -390 0; dur: 8000; loop: true; easing: linear">
            <a-torus radius="0.95" radius-tubular="0.018"
                material="color: #facc15; emissive: #eab308; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.75; transparent: true">
            </a-torus>
            <a-sphere radius="0.08" position="-0.95 0 0" 
                material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #facc15; emissiveIntensity: 1">
            </a-sphere>
        </a-entity>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 4. LIBRO REALISTA IZQUIERDO (Tomo I - Carmesí Imperial) -->
    <a-entity position="-3.3 -0.2 0.3" rotation="12 28 -10"
        animation="property: position; to: -3.3 0.35 0.3; dir: alternate; dur: 3200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine"
        animation__rot="property: rotation; to: 8 36 -6; dir: alternate; dur: 4500; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Tapa trasera -->
        <a-box width="1.3" height="1.8" depth="0.05" position="0 0 -0.1" 
            material="color: #7f1d1d; roughness: 0.4; metalness: 0.2">
        </a-box>
        <!-- Tapa delantera con relieve -->
        <a-box width="1.3" height="1.8" depth="0.05" position="0 0 0.1" 
            material="color: #991b1b; roughness: 0.4; metalness: 0.2">
        </a-box>
        <!-- Escudo / Marco dorado de la portada -->
        <a-plane width="0.75" height="1.1" position="0 0 0.13"
            material="color: #d97706; emissive: #b45309; emissiveIntensity: 0.4; roughness: 0.3; metalness: 0.8">
        </a-plane>
        <!-- Hojas de papel marfil cálido -->
        <a-box width="1.18" height="1.68" depth="0.18" position="0.04 0 0" 
            material="color: #fef3c7; roughness: 0.8">
        </a-box>
        <!-- Lomo curvado -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.11" height="1.8" position="-0.62 0 0" theta-length="180" rotation="0 90 0"
            material="color: #7f1d1d; roughness: 0.4">
        </a-cylinder>
        <!-- Cinta separadora dorada colgando -->
        <a-box width="0.12" height="0.6" depth="0.02" position="0.1 -0.98 0" rotation="0 0 -15"
            material="color: #fbbf24; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.6">
        </a-box>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 5. LIBRO REALISTA DERECHO (Tomo II - Azul Zafiro) -->
    <a-entity position="3.3 -0.2 0.3" rotation="-10 -25 10"
        animation="property: position; to: 3.3 0.35 0.3; dir: alternate; dur: 3600; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine"
        animation__rot="property: rotation; to: -6 -32 6; dir: alternate; dur: 4800; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Tapa trasera -->
        <a-box width="1.3" height="1.8" depth="0.05" position="0 0 -0.1" 
            material="color: #1e3a8a; roughness: 0.4; metalness: 0.2">
        </a-box>
        <!-- Tapa delantera con relieve -->
        <a-box width="1.3" height="1.8" depth="0.05" position="0 0 0.1" 
            material="color: #1d4ed8; roughness: 0.4; metalness: 0.2">
        </a-box>
        <!-- Escudo / Marco cian metálico de la portada -->
        <a-plane width="0.75" height="1.1" position="0 0 0.13"
            material="color: #38bdf8; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.5; roughness: 0.3; metalness: 0.8">
        </a-plane>
        <!-- Hojas de papel marfil cálido -->
        <a-box width="1.18" height="1.68" depth="0.18" position="-0.04 0 0" 
            material="color: #fef3c7; roughness: 0.8">
        </a-box>
        <!-- Lomo curvado -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.11" height="1.8" position="0.62 0 0" theta-length="180" rotation="0 -90 0"
            material="color: #1e3a8a; roughness: 0.4">
        </a-cylinder>
        <!-- Cinta separadora cian colgando -->
        <a-box width="0.12" height="0.6" depth="0.02" position="-0.1 -0.98 0" rotation="0 0 15"
            material="color: #38bdf8; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.6">
        </a-box>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 6. CRISTALES MÁGICOS DE SABIDURÍA (Chispas giratorias) -->
    <a-octahedron radius="0.16" position="-2 1.6 0.2"
        material="color: #facc15; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.7; metalness: 0.6; roughness: 0.2"
        animation="property: rotation; to: 360 360 0; dur: 5000; loop: true; easing: linear"
        animation__pos="property: position; to: -2 1.9 0.2; dir: alternate; dur: 2200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
    </a-octahedron>
    <a-octahedron radius="0.16" position="2 1.6 0.2"
        material="color: #38bdf8; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; metalness: 0.6; roughness: 0.2"
        animation="property: rotation; to: -360 360 0; dur: 5500; loop: true; easing: linear"
        animation__pos="property: position; to: 2 1.9 0.2; dir: alternate; dur: 2600; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
    </a-octahedron>

    <!-- 7. TIPOGRAFÍA Y MENSAJE HOLOGRÁFICO (Flotando al centro) -->
    <a-entity position="0 0 0.4" 
        animation="property: position; to: 0 0.18 0.4; dir: alternate; dur: 2300; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        
        <!-- Insignia Superior: UNIDAD I -->
        <a-plane width="1.8" height="0.38" position="0 0.95 0"
            material="color: #0f172a; opacity: 0.7; transparent: true; roughness: 0.5">
            <a-text value="🎓 UNIDAD I" align="center" color="#38bdf8" width="3.2" position="0 0 0.02"></a-text>
        </a-plane>

        <!-- Resplandor Neón Azul (Capa trasera inflada) -->
        <a-text 
            value="METODOLOGIA DE LA\nINVESTIGACION" 
            color="#0284c7" 
            align="center" 
            width="5.3"
            line-height="62"
            position="0.02 0.08 -0.06">
        </a-text>

        <!-- Texto Principal: Blanco nítido al frente -->
        <a-text 
            value="METODOLOGIA DE LA\nINVESTIGACION" 
            color="#ffffff" 
            align="center" 
            width="5.1"
            line-height="62"
            position="0 0.1 0">
        </a-text>

        <!-- Subtítulo Dorado -->
        <a-text 
            value="✦ Ciencia  •  Metodo  •  Conocimiento ✦" 
            color="#facc15" 
            align="center" 
            width="3.6"
            position="0 -0.65 0">
        </a-text>
    </a-entity>

</a-entity>
